[attribute-subj-group-type]
=== `@subj-group-type` Type of Subject Group

General subject, discipline, field of study, or information class of a particular <<element-subj-group,`<subj-group>`>> element.

#### Usage/Remarks
To name a specific controlled vocabulary, use the attribute <<attribute-vocab,`@vocab`>>. This <<attribute-subj-group-type,`@subj-group-type`>> attribute may be used in addition to the <<attribute-vocab,`@vocab`>> attribute in the case where a vocabulary or one of its sub-vocabularies is also a known field of study, term of art, or the name of a discipline.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-subj-group,`<subj-group>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| Type of subject.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===

#### Tagged Sample
